scenes.tts: Chapter one located one contribution in the first touch neuron without making it the whole story. If several mice over-react to the same puff, did the same circuit defect cause it? Keep the colour map: gold sensory neuron, teal dorsal horn, blue brain.
scenes.visual: Open on chapter one's full skin-to-brain pathway in the same positions and colours. Repeat one fixed puff into three mouse lanes. Their red movement gauges rise to similar schematic heights. Place a large question mark over three different blank sites along the shared pathway.
scenes.narration: Chapter one located one contribution in the first touch neuron without making it the whole story. If several mice over-react to the same puff, did the same circuit defect cause it? Keep the colour map: gold sensory neuron, teal dorsal horn, blue brain.

scenes.tts: Start at the gold neuron's terminal inside the teal dorsal horn. In M E C P two and G A B R B three models, evidence supported reduced GABA A receptor-dependent presynaptic inhibition. Receptor-associated puncta fell, afferent-evoked quantal release rose, and dorsal root potentials shrank.
scenes.caption: Start at the gold neuron's terminal inside the teal dorsal horn. In Mecp2 and Gabrb3 models, evidence supported reduced GABA-A-receptor-dependent presynaptic inhibition. Receptor-associated puncta fell, afferent-evoked quantal release rose, and dorsal root potentials shrank.
scenes.visual: Zoom into the gold terminal while keeping the teal dorsal-horn border visible. Labelled GABA-A blocks shrink in number. A release gauge rises and a dorsal-root-potential trace shrinks. Mark the gauges and the trace 'schematic'; represent puncta as labelled dots, never receptor structures. Transform the three changes into one bounded label: 'authors' presynaptic-inhibition account'.
scenes.narration: Start at the gold neuron's terminal inside the teal dorsal horn. In Mecp2 and Gabrb3 models, evidence supported reduced GABA-A-receptor-dependent presynaptic inhibition. Receptor-associated puncta fell, afferent-evoked quantal release rose, and dorsal root potentials shrank.

scenes.tts: Reset the pathway. The Shank three model did not show that terminal G A B R B three change. Cultured large sensory neurons instead had reduced I h and greater excitability. The Shank three model therefore reached a similar tactile endpoint through a different measured defect.
scenes.caption: Reset the pathway. The Shank3 model did not show that terminal GABRB3 change. Cultured large sensory neurons instead had reduced Ih and greater excitability. The Shank3 model therefore reached a similar tactile endpoint through a different measured defect.
scenes.visual: Restore the terminal blocks and zoom back along the gold neuron. A gauge labelled 'Ih' falls while schematic spikes crowd closer together and travel toward the cord. Split the frame just enough to retain the previous GABA route as a small labelled outline. Join both routes at the same red air-puff movement gauge.
scenes.narration: Reset the pathway. The Shank3 model did not show that terminal GABRB3 change. Cultured large sensory neurons instead had reduced Ih and greater excitability. The Shank3 model therefore reached a similar tactile endpoint through a different measured defect.

scenes.tts: The same tactile endpoint can arise from different defects in these mouse models. M E C P two and G A B R B three models support a reduced presynaptic GABA A inhibition account. The Shank three model instead showed reduced I h and greater sensory-neuron excitability.
scenes.caption: The same tactile endpoint can arise from different defects in these mouse models. Mecp2 and Gabrb3 models support a reduced presynaptic GABA-A inhibition account. The Shank3 model instead showed reduced Ih and greater sensory-neuron excitability.
scenes.visual: Turn the two route outlines into two moving branches feeding one red endpoint. Left branch: labelled GABA-A terminal brake decreases. Right branch: labelled Ih gauge decreases and spike density rises. Keep 'mouse assay endpoint' under the red gauge so the picture never implies a shared experience.
scenes.narration: The same tactile endpoint can arise from different defects in these mouse models. Mecp2 and Gabrb3 models support a reduced presynaptic GABA-A inhibition account. The Shank3 model instead showed reduced Ih and greater sensory-neuron excitability.

scenes.tts: Mechanism is only one axis. Slide a timeline beneath four mouse-model lanes, from postnatal day four to adult testing. Every lane later shows a tactile abnormality. Must every adult tactile phenotype already be present at postnatal day four?
scenes.visual: Pull the route map upward and grow a wide P4-to-adult timeline below it. Add four moving lane labels: 'Gabrb3', 'Mecp2', 'Nlgn2', 'Rorb'. Place red adult endpoint markers in all four lanes. Leave all four P4 cells empty with question marks.
scenes.narration: Mechanism is only one axis. Slide a timeline beneath four mouse-model lanes, from postnatal day four to adult testing. Every lane later shows a tactile abnormality. Must every adult tactile phenotype already be present at postnatal day four?

scenes.visual: Thinking pause. Keep all four lanes and the question visible. A time cursor drifts slowly from P4 toward adult, but stops before the outcome cells. Do not reveal any lane.

scenes.tts: No. Gabrb3 and Mecp2 loss-of-function pups were already more reactive at day four. Nlgn2 and Rorb mutants were not, although both showed tactile abnormalities as adults. Two sampled ages separate early from later onset, but do not identify the onset day.
scenes.caption: No. Gabrb3 and Mecp2 loss-of-function pups were already more reactive at P4. Nlgn2 and Rorb mutants were not, although both showed tactile abnormalities as adults. Two sampled ages separate early from later onset, but do not identify the onset day.
scenes.visual: Reveal red P4 markers only in the Gabrb3 and Mecp2 lanes. Keep neutral P4 markers for Nlgn2 and Rorb, then animate their red markers appearing by adulthood. Add a bracket between sampled ages labelled 'onset day unknown'. The time cursor continues moving.
scenes.narration: No. Gabrb3 and Mecp2 loss-of-function pups were already more reactive at P4. Nlgn2 and Rorb mutants were not, although both showed tactile abnormalities as adults. Two sampled ages separate early from later onset, but do not identify the onset day.

scenes.tts: Nlgn2 also changed the locus. Deleting it from dorsal-horn neurons was sufficient for adult tactile alterations. Emphasise the teal spinal block, not the gold afferent. Across these models, early reactivity tracked selected later behaviours, but that association did not prove causation.
scenes.visual: Return to the full pathway. Dim the gold neuron and enlarge the teal dorsal-horn block. Remove an 'Nlgn2' badge only from teal dorsal-horn neurons, then raise the adult red movement gauge. Beside the timeline, draw a dashed association arrow toward selected later assay tiles and label it 'association, not causation'.
scenes.narration: Nlgn2 also changed the locus. Deleting it from dorsal-horn neurons was sufficient for adult tactile alterations. Emphasise the teal spinal block, not the gold afferent. Across these models, early reactivity tracked selected later behaviours, but that association did not prove causation.

scenes.tts: Locus, mechanism and developmental timing must be tested separately. A shared mouse movement cannot choose among them. Conditional genetics locates a sufficient contribution. Physiology tests a mechanism. Measurements at different ages map a schedule without turning association into a human developmental rule.
scenes.visual: Transform the pathway into three large coordinated trackers while keeping its colours: a location spotlight moves among gold and teal; a mechanism fork switches between GABA-A and Ih; a timeline cursor moves from P4 to adult. All three converge on the red mouse-assay gauge, then separate again.
scenes.narration: Locus, mechanism and developmental timing must be tested separately. A shared mouse movement cannot choose among them. Conditional genetics locates a sufficient contribution. Physiology tests a mechanism. Measurements at different ages map a schedule without turning association into a human developmental rule.

scenes.tts: The map explains why one endpoint cannot name its cause. It does not turn air-puff movement into perception, or mouse development into a human window. Those translation questions need their own measurements.
scenes.visual: Return from the three trackers to the full pathway and red mouse-assay gauge. Place a human outline beyond a dashed boundary. The movement gauge remains on the mouse side. A separate empty human-measurement frame appears, labelled 'new evidence needed', while the timeline stops at the boundary.
scenes.narration: The map explains why one endpoint cannot name its cause. It does not turn air-puff movement into perception, or mouse development into a human window. Those translation questions need their own measurements.

scenes.visual: End card with the three moving trackers behind it. Large line, six words: 'Test locus, mechanism and timing separately.' Keep the gold, teal, blue and red colour map unchanged.
